commandId.description: The command ID as generated by the CSC.

lines24V.description: Groups all 24 V lines feedback. True means that 24 V are present in the line.

manualRotation.description: True means manual rotation is active.

valves.description: Percentage value of the valves used for thermal control of +IFTP.PDC1 cabinet and azimuth motors.

adbsLocalBoxEmergencyPushbutton.description: True means the emergency pushbutton is pressed.

iftpPdc1Doors.description: True means the cabinet doors are closed.

adbsLoto.description: True if external LOTO mechanism at 6th floor is active.

brakes.description: True if az brakes are disengaged.

lines24V.description: Groups all 24 V lines feedback. True means that 24 V are present in the line.

lockingPins.description: Groups the status of all locking pins.

alarms.description: Indicates hardware alarms. True means the alarm is active.

doorsClosed.description: Indicates what cabinet doors are closed. True means the door is closed.

cabinetFan.description: Indicates if the fans of the following cabinets are running. True means fan running.

limitSwitches.description: Indicates the status of the limit switches in the dome. True means limit switch engaged.

selectors.description: Indicates the status of the selectors that enable the local pushbuttons of the cabinets. The ones for the louvers include also the currently selected louver for a given group. For example, llbvLocalBox3LouverSelected indicates with a number what is the louver selected among E1, E2, E3, F2, F3.

llbvRadLouverSelected.description: Index of louver selected, among F1 (15), G1 (18), or none (value 0).

llbvLocalBox1LouverSelected.description: Index of louver selected, among A1 (1), A2 (2), B1 (3), B2 (4), B3 (5), or none (value 0).

llbvLocalBox2LouverSelected.description: Index of louver selected, among C1 (6), C2 (7), C3 (8), D1 (9), D2 (10), D3 (11) or none (value 0).

llbvLocalBox3LouverSelected.description: Index of louver selected, among E1 (12), E2 (13), E3 (14), F2 (16), F3 (17), or none (value 0).

llbvLocalBox4LouverSelected.description: Index of louver selected, among G2 (19), G3 (20), H1 (21), H2 (22), H3 (23), or none (value 0).

llbvLocalBox5LouverSelected.description: Index of louver selected, among I1 (24), I2 (25), I3 (26), L1 (27), L2 (28), L3 (29) or none (value 0).

llbvLocalBox6LouverSelected.description: Index of louver selected, among M1 (30), M2 (31), M3 (32), N1 (33), N2 (34), or none (value 0).

emergencyPushbuttons.description: Indicates which emergency pushbuttons are pressed. True means emergency pushbutton pressed

powerAvailable.description: Indicates if the given subsystem receives input power. True means power is received.

hatches.description: Indicates what hatches are closed and if the corresponding override is active. True means hatch closed, for the override signals it means override active.

photocells.description: Indicates if the photocell is not blocked by something. True means photocell clear.

apsSwitchedOn.description: True means that the photocells are switched on. False means that the photocells are switched off to avoid light emission.

lightCurtain.description: Indicates if the light curtain is not blocked by something. True means light curtain clear.

lights.description: Indicates which light circuit is switched on at the moment. True means circuit switched on.

heatingCables.description: Indicates which heating cable is active. True means cable is heating.

brakes.description: Indicates which brakes are disengaged. True means brakes disengaged.
